summary: Concorde International Group Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of Mr. Philip Ling Yan Wong from the Board and as Co-CEO effective June 28, 2026. The resignation is to focus on YOOV Group Holding Limited management, not due to any disagreement. This is an abrupt departure of a co-CEO and director, constituting a management change event. No terms, advisor, or mechanics are provided. Watch for potential succession clarity or further board restructuring.
